preamble: Assibilation of /d/ before a high front vowel to the voiced alveolo-palatal affricate [dʑ]. In Late Middle Japanese (12th–16th centuries) /t, d/ affricated before /i/ and /u/: /di/ ぢ became [dʑi] (and /du/ づ [dzu]); ぢ later merged with じ in the yotsugana merger.

examples.note: In Late Middle Japanese (12th–16th centuries) /t, d/ affricated before /i, u/: /ti, di/ became [tɕi, dʑi] and /tu, du/ became [tsu, dzu]. In Standard Japanese ぢ is now pronounced like じ.
